definition_prose: M2_PLUS is the observed proportion of eligible draws in the artifact's evaluation window for which the method's native ticket set contained at least one ticket matching 2 or more of that draw's winning main numbers. Computed by lottolab.research.base_method_evaluation as the exact rational success_draw_count / eligible_draw_count; the denominator is the window's eligible draw count. Descriptive only: this definition commits no ranking direction, threshold, admission gate, or significance claim, and the module that computes it never ranks, promotes, rejects, or removes a method. The random_reference and delta_vs_random the evaluator computes alongside this value are evaluator-internal comparison semantics and are deliberately not persisted as separate metric results.
